description: Prepare an LP loan (a fixed-cost USDG loan against an ETH/USDG or stock/USDG liquidity position on Uniswap v3 or v4, SushiSwap v3, Ramses or Fables, with no liquidation: it is never closed early because a price moves, and if it is not repaid by its end the position is unwound for its lenders and nothing else is taken): the position is approved to the lane's core and moves into its own escrow, and the loan's USDG less the fee comes to the wallet. A Uniswap v4 position leaves any subscription it has (a rewards program that tracks it) as it moves. Fables receipts not wrapped yet (rangeId, gage_lp_positions fablesReceipts) are wrapped into a position first, any staked ones unstaked, and the borrow follows once the wrap is mined. Refused above maxCostBps. Use the prepare object of gage_lp_quote, without its action. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

adapter.description: The position's adapter: one gage_capabilities lists under lpLane.adapters (Uniswap v3, SushiSwap v3, Ramses V3, Uniswap v4 or Fables; gage_lp_positions names each position's)

maxCostBps.description: Highest loan cost you accept, bps of the amount borrowed; refused above it

rangeId.description: Fables receipts not wrapped yet (gage_lp_positions fablesReceipts), with the Fables adapter: they are wrapped into a position first, unstaking any staked, then borrowed against; name tokenId or rangeId, not both

term.description: Loan term in seconds, one of gage_capabilities lpLane.terms

tokenId.description: The position's id (gage_lp_positions); or rangeId for Fables receipts not wrapped yet

vault.description: The LP vault to borrow from; the lane's first one that can fund the loan whole when omitted

name: gage_prepare_lp_borrow
title: Prepare: Borrow against an LP position
